decisions.reason: The air situation display fits the integrated tower and surveillance direction and costs little to maintain, but it has not been observed since 2018, so its value remains uncertain and the option stays open.
The airport systems training program is a low-cost service tied to the installed base, and keeping it supports customer relationships while post-pandemic demand recovers.
The airfield ground lighting training course complements the firm's core lighting business at minimal cost, though it could be merged into the broader training program.

The collaboration software tool supports the strategic move toward collaborative decision-making, and its prospects remain uncertain after the pandemic disrupted the airport market, so the cheap option is worth holding.
The multilateration system is the flagship of the surveillance direction with high strategic upside, and abandoning it before airport investment recovers would destroy option value.
